blocks.hero.eyebrow: Southern Indiana · In person in Louisville
blocks.hero.subhead: Freedom Counseling Services is just across the river in Louisville's Middletown area, about a 20-minute drive from New Albany, Jeffersonville, and Clarksville, and close to Sellersburg, Floyds Knobs, and Charlestown. Southern Indiana clients meet with us in person at our office.

facts.text: Choose your counselor, or let us match you

blocks.request.heading: Ready to start, just across the river?
blocks.request.text: Request an appointment in about a minute, or call (502) 523-2970. Most people are seen the same week.

sections.body: A Kentucky counselor doesn't have to mean a long trip. Our office sits just off I-64 near Blankenbaker Parkway, about 20 minutes from New Albany, Jeffersonville, Clarksville, and Watson. For many Southern Indiana clients, it's an easy drive after work or on a lunch break.
sections.heading: Closer than you might think
Getting here from Southern Indiana
sections.body:
- **From New Albany:** take I-64 East across the Sherman Minton Bridge (no toll) and stay on I-64 East to the Blankenbaker Parkway exit.
- **From Jeffersonville and Clarksville:** the Clark Memorial (Second Street) Bridge is also toll-free. The I-65 bridges (Lincoln and Kennedy) and the Lewis and Clark (East End) Bridge charge a RiverLink toll; see RiverLink.com for current rates.
- **Then:** we're just off Blankenbaker Parkway, across from Southeast Christian Church, in the office complex behind Heine Brothers Coffee.

Our counselors are licensed in Kentucky. The law requires a counselor to be licensed in the state where you are during a session, so we can't meet with Indiana clients online. When you come to our Louisville office, you're in Kentucky, and we can work with you fully, with the same counselors and the same care as every client.

blocks.faith.heading: Faith at the center, never forced
blocks.faith.body: Every Freedom counselor brings together a biblical worldview, Christian theology, and the best clinical practice. When you want it, your counselor can pray with you, open Scripture, and talk about where God is in what you're facing. If you'd rather not, you'll get the same excellent care, and your counselor follows your lead. Christians from every tradition are welcome. [How faith works at Freedom](/christian-counseling)
blocks.team.heading: Choose your counselor
blocks.team.note: Every counselor is accepting new clients.
blocks.office.heading: Finding our office
blocks.office.directions: Just off Blankenbaker Parkway, across from Southeast Christian Church, in the office complex behind Heine Brothers Coffee. Parking is right outside.
blocks.expect.heading: Your first visit
blocks.expect.body: Your first session is mostly a conversation: your counselor getting to know you and what brought you in. There's nothing to prepare. Sessions are 50 minutes.
blocks.cost.heading: What it costs
blocks.cost.body: $50 to $165 per session, depending on your counselor, the same as for every client. We don't bill insurance, but you can pay with an HSA or FSA card, and we'll give you a superbill to submit for possible out-of-network reimbursement.
